outcome: prevalence of anemia in postnatal women
risk factors for anemia in postnatal women
finding: The study found a 52% prevalence of postpartum anemia, with higher risk in older women, rural residents, those with lower education and socioeconomic status, higher parity, low birth weight infants, and cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Women who had cesarean deliveries were more likely to develop postpartum anemia compared to those who had vaginal deliveries.
